verdict.rationale: cubic documents several natural-language control surfaces. In PR comments you can ask questions, trigger reviews and fix issues (e.g. "@cubic-dev-ai review this PR"), and a chat sidebar accepts requests like "tour this PR". Its MCP server also lets a coding agent request reviews, triage issues and manage subscriptions and seats from natural-language prompts. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably, and evidence that configuration (cubic.yaml, custom agents) can be changed by natural language rather than YAML editing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Interact with cubic in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues.
Ask chat to "tour this PR" for a step-by-step review of the changes and what to check.
You can now ask your coding agent to check your cubic subscription, manage team seats and roles, and purchase more seats without leaving your MCP client.
Connect cubic's MCP server to your coding agent to read review findings and codebase context, request PR reviews, and triage PR or codebase scan issues.
Ask follow-up questions about code changes without leaving the PR
